question: Generate a pie chart to show the distribution of cancer grades across all patients.

files.eval_guideline: Pie chart must show proportional slices with percentage labels for each cancer grade; color scheme and font may differ.
files.match_reasoning: The files have identical filenames and matching .png image formats. Both correspond to the requested pie chart showing the distribution of cancer grades across all patients.
files.strategy_reasoning: The guideline requires correct proportional slices and percentage labels for each cancer grade while allowing colors and fonts to vary. Semantic comparison evaluates these visual requirements without requiring pixel-level agreement.

comparison_details.explanation: Both images show the same cancer grade distribution with proportional pie slices and matching percentage labels: Grade I 24.2%, Grade II 29.2%, Grade III 35.0%, and Grade IV 11.7%. Both convey that Grade III is most common and Grade IV is least common. The candidate additionally reports 120 patients and counts of 29, 35, 42, and 14, respectively, which are consistent with the displayed percentages. Differences in colors, slice direction, typography, white slice borders, and legend placement are cosmetic and do not alter interpretation. The candidate satisfies all evaluation requirements, with no critical missing elements or conflicting data.
